# Release the approved Faith Reins favicon

Chrome currently receives Wix's transparent 16 × 16 placeholder at `/favicon.svg` and `/favicon.png`, despite the correct artwork in the repository.

The shared page layout now points to `/assets/v7/site-icon-64.png` and `/assets/v7/site-icon.svg`. Both are byte-for-byte copies of the existing website favicon assets, whose horse paths match the approved v7 master. The PNG provides a 64 × 64 fallback; the SVG is declared with `sizes="any"`. The existing Apple touch icon continues to use its current URL.

Validation: build the public pages and protected account runtime through the PR preview workflow, then verify the production home, service, shop and account pages declare the new URLs and that both live icon responses contain the expected artwork and MIME types.

Production target: the existing Faith Reins site, `2d8c6050-5730-4bed-9c7a-266ca7bd00b4` (`https://www.faithreins.com/`).
